body: Hello @Sergey80, does http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui still work though?
Does it make any difference if you set the path to "/abc/" ? I am guessing there is a missing / somewhere in our integration code.

If quarkus.http.root-path is not set then by https://localhost:8080/swagger-ui works otherwise doesn't.
As soon as that path has set, things start to break. This bug, and there are others related to it. Reported before.
Which version of Quarkus is this? I haven't been able to reproduce this in a quick test against upstream master.
I know we fixed some issues in this area recently.
1.0.0.CR1. i see there a new version. let me try.

same with <quarkus.version>1.0.0.Final</quarkus.version>. maybe it is fixed on master. but I am reporting from the user perspective. we are going to use it on prod one day soon. researching where it fails and if we are ready to go with it.

Related bug: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/5494 (makes tests not look real, hitting the wrong endpoints)

Hello @Sergey80, I just tested with `1.0.0.Final` and it indeed seems to be working oddly there. 

I won't be able to look more into it now, but instead of http://localhost:8080/abc/swagger-ui  can you try http://localhost:8080/abc/swagger-ui/ (notice the / at the end of the URL)? That worked for me on 1.0.0.Final.
yes http://localhost:8080/abc/swagger-ui/ with that extra / works for me. thanks.
I think it would probably be better to fix it as I remember we support that for some other feature. So if we can make it work, let's make it work.
at least this https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/5494 should be fixed.

issue.title: Adjust swagger-ui path if HTTP root is set
